caveats: Every row was run against a scripted model. That tests the plumbing, not what a real model would say.
The harness ran as a plain process on this machine: no wall. Nothing here shows the cell is sealed.
A tool gate inside the harness is a guardrail. It stops mistakes, not an attacker with a shell.

rows.title: a delivered turn gives exactly one reply, from the model, for the right turn
overheard lines arrive as context on the next turn and cause no reply
a dropped message never reaches the model
a tool the harness was offered, then denied, does not run
a tool the policy never allowed is not offered to the harness and does not run
a shell tool on the allow list does not run once the agent is public
positive control: an allowed tool does run
no verdict means no run
the veto inside the cell says no on its own when nobody answers it
no real secret is readable from a tool, and the key swap happened (process level)
the harness process reached for nothing outside this machine (process level, its own runtime only)
usage is counted, and the turn after the budget is spent is refused
a policy change takes effect on the next message with no restart
the tools a turn may use follow the policy as it is at that turn, in a session that is already running
what the harness remembers from one room never reaches another, because a harness with one memory is refused a second room
a harness that owns chat runs with its channels off and holds no chat credential
